page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a running head at the top centre; a verse quotation set in italic lines in the middle of the column; the right edge of the page is cut off by the scan. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: paterna virtute maior, ruentem eius occasu patriam subiectis humeris sustentasti, qui obiectu virtutis tuae stitisti ingruentem Hispanorum furorem, ac saeuitiam, retudisti strictas in nos gladiorum acies, propulsasti denique ab aris, ac focis, ab uxoribus, ac liberis nostris immanem crudelissimae gentis audaciam. Arbitrabantur praecipitatos in calamitosam ruinam miseros Belgas, trucidato infami latrocinio felicis memoriae inuictissimo Principe Wilhelmo Patre tuo, ignari profecto eius quod dicitur
main_text.l: Est in iuvencis, est in equis patrum
main_text.p: Falli eos opinione sua docuisti, exortus e felici arbore felicior surculus, in eamque repente adultus magnitudinem, ut ramorum tuorum obtentu vniuersum Bel-

page.notes: The right portion of the page is cut off by the edge of the scan, so the last line is incomplete. Some words near the edges are faint. Transcription of the Latin is from the visible text; the running head reads DEDICATIO in small capitals.
